blurb:
Visit the historic Boch Center Wang Theatre and take a 1-hour behind-the-scenes tour of one of Boston’s most prominent theatrical landmarks - plus get an exclusive look at the Folk Americana Roots Hall of Fame! Stand on the stage graced by Lady Gaga, Bing Crosby, Bruce Springsteen, Neil Young, Ella Fitzgerald, Mikhail Baryshnikov, Janet Jackson, Queen, Benny Goodman, Elton John, Hugh Jackman, Liza Minnelli, Diana Ross and more! Please note that all areas of the theatre are subject to availability based on the performance and event schedule. 

The Boch Center Wang Theatre is listed on the National Register of Historic Places and has been one of the premiere theatrical destinations in Boston since opening in 1925. Rivaled by few other theatres in the world, it boasts a seating capacity of 3,500 and one of the five largest stages in the U.S. This tour allows guests of all ages to experience many aspects of the theatre like never before!
